meta.title: AimTrainerPro - Online Aim Trainer
meta.description: Free online aim trainer to improve your FPS aim

home.subtitle: Sharpen your aim for Valorant, CS2, Apex Legends, Fortnite, and Overwatch 2 with precision 3D drills — right in your browser. No download required.
home.fineprint: AimTrainerPro is a free browser-based 3D aim trainer for FPS players across every game. No installs, no sign-up.

about.mission: Our mission is to help gamers improve their aim through accessible, browser-based training tools that require no downloads or installations.

flicking.title: Flicking
flicking.desc: Train rapid, snapping movements to hit targets that appear suddenly across your screen.

tracking.title: Tracking
tracking.desc: Practice keeping your crosshair locked on moving targets with smooth, consistent mouse control.

speed.title: Speed
speed.desc: Push your click speed to the limit while maintaining accuracy under time pressure.

precision.title: Precision
precision.desc: Develop pinpoint accuracy by hitting small targets with minimal wasted movement.

reaction.title: Reaction
reaction.desc: Sharpen your reaction time by responding to visual cues as quickly as possible.

gameSpecific.title: Game-Specific
gameSpecific.desc: Practice drills tailored to scenarios found in Valorant, CS2, Apex Legends, and more.

about.whoItIsFor: AimTrainerPro is for anyone looking to improve their FPS performance — from casual players to competitive grinders.
about.whyBrowser: No downloads, no installs, no waiting. Train directly in your browser on any device with zero friction.

faq.a1: Yes, all core training exercises are completely free with no hidden costs.
faq.q2: Do I need to create an account?
faq.a2: No account is required to start training. Sign up only if you want to save progress and appear on leaderboards.
faq.q3: Will this actually improve my aim in-game?
faq.a3: Consistent practice with our drills builds muscle memory that directly translates to better performance in FPS games.
faq.a4: AimTrainerPro works on all modern browsers including Chrome, Firefox, Edge, and Safari.

about.disclaimer: AimTrainerPro is an independent project and is not affiliated with any game publisher or developer.

blog.title: Aim Training Tips & Guides
blog.subtitle: Expert advice, game strategies, and training techniques to level up your aim.

flick_micro.name: Micro Flick
flick_micro.desc: Train precise small-angle flicks between 5° and 15°. Targets spawn close to your crosshair, demanding pixel-perfect adjustments.

flick_medium.name: Medium Flick
flick_medium.desc: Practice standard-distance flicks between 16° and 90°. Simulates common FPS engagements at moderate angles from your crosshair.

flick_wide.name: Wide Flick
flick_wide.desc: Master extreme-angle flicks between 91° and 180°. Targets appear behind or to the side, training fast 180° snaps.

flick_headshot.name: Headshot Flick
flick_headshot.desc: Only critical-zone hits count. Each target has a small headshot zone at 30% of standard radius. Land it for 2x points.

flick_multi_target.name: Sequential Elimination
flick_multi_target.desc: Multiple targets spawn simultaneously with numeric labels. Eliminate them in order — hitting out of sequence counts as a miss.

flick_multi_target_easy.name: Sequential Elimination (Easy)
flick_multi_target_easy.desc: A beginner-friendly version with only 2 targets per wave. Learn to read numeric labels and eliminate in order.

flick_multi_target_hard.name: Sequential Elimination (Hard)
flick_multi_target_hard.desc: The ultimate test — 6 targets spawn at wide angles with small hitboxes. Rapid sequenced flicks under time pressure.

tracking_linear_strafe.name: Linear Strafing
tracking_linear_strafe.desc: Track a target moving at constant velocity in a straight line. Builds fundamental tracking muscle memory.

tracking_sinusoidal.name: Sinusoidal Movement
tracking_sinusoidal.desc: Track a target following a smooth sinusoidal curve. Trains your ability to predict and follow non-linear paths.

tracking_random_direction.name: Random Direction Changes
tracking_random_direction.desc: Track a target that changes direction unpredictably at 500ms–2000ms intervals. Develops reactive tracking ability.

tracking_acceleration.name: Acceleration & Deceleration
tracking_acceleration.desc: Track a target that varies speed between 25% and 100% of base movement speed. Trains dynamic speed adjustment.

speed_blitz.name: Speed Blitz
speed_blitz.desc: Targets appear rapidly across the screen. Click as many as possible before they disappear. Tests raw click speed.

speed_frenzy.name: Target Frenzy
speed_frenzy.desc: Multiple targets spawn simultaneously and must be cleared before the next wave. Each wave increases target count.

speed_switch.name: Rapid Switch
speed_switch.desc: Two targets appear on opposite sides of the screen. Alternate clicks between them as fast as possible.

speed_cascade.name: Cascade
speed_cascade.desc: Targets fall from the top of the screen at increasing speed. Click them before they reach the bottom.

speed_gridshot.name: Gridshot Sprint
speed_gridshot.desc: A 3x3 grid of targets lights up in random patterns. Clear highlighted targets before the next pattern appears.

speed_burst.name: Burst Fire
speed_burst.desc: Targets appear in quick bursts of 3–5. Eliminate the entire burst before the next one spawns. Rewards controlled aggression.

precision_pixel_hunt.name: Pixel Hunt
precision_pixel_hunt.desc: Tiny targets appear at random positions. Take your time and land every shot. Trains fine motor control.

precision_dot_drill.name: Dot Drill
precision_dot_drill.desc: Small dots appear on a grid. Hit each dot precisely without clicking outside. Accuracy is paramount.

precision_headshot_master.name: Headshot Master
precision_headshot_master.desc: Targets have a visible critical zone. Only hits within the critical zone count. Trains crosshair placement.

precision_micro_correct.name: Micro Correction
precision_micro_correct.desc: After each shot, the next target spawns very close to the previous position. Trains micro-adjustments.

precision_shrinking_targets.name: Shrinking Targets
precision_shrinking_targets.desc: Targets start large and shrink over time. Click before they disappear. Wait longer for a higher precision bonus.

precision_steady_hand.name: Steady Hand
precision_steady_hand.desc: Hold your cursor within a small zone for 500ms to register a hit. Tests cursor stability and patience.

reaction_flash.name: Flash Reflex
reaction_flash.desc: A single target flashes on screen for a brief moment. Click it before it disappears. Tests pure reaction time.

reaction_pop_shot.name: Pop Shot
reaction_pop_shot.desc: Targets pop up from behind cover at unpredictable intervals. React and fire during the brief exposure window.

reaction_color_trigger.name: Color Trigger
reaction_color_trigger.desc: A red target appears, then turns green after a brief delay. Fire only when green — clicking red costs points.

reaction_wall_peek.name: Wall Peek
reaction_wall_peek.desc: A target slides out from behind a wall, holds briefly, then retreats. Punish the peek before it disappears.

reaction_multi_stimulus.name: Multi-Stimulus
reaction_multi_stimulus.desc: A single target lights up at one of several positions, never the same spot twice in a row. Snap to it fast.

reaction_speed_ladder.name: Speed Ladder
reaction_speed_ladder.desc: Each target you hit makes the next one disappear faster. The window keeps shrinking until you can no longer keep up.
